load_prompt_template: load a named prompt template from prompts directory and substitute placeholders with provided values
load_knowledge_bundle: load combined domain knowledge by concatenating markdown files from knowledge and platform prompt directories
load_prompt_directory: load and concatenate all markdown files under a prompt subdirectory recursively
render_headspace_prompt: render the headspace phase prompt template with knowledge and pipeline code placeholders
assemble_agent_context: assemble workflow agent context by loading knowledge and platform prompt directories
